page.layout: One page of text in a single column with a running head above and page number at top right; a faint show-through text block (from the reverse side) is visible in the lower and right margin and is not transcribed; a woodcut ornament sits below the text; catchword/signature line "SECT." at the foot right; a narrow column of faint marginal text at the right margin is show-through and not transcribed.

main_text.p: sancto dictata? Quid hoc aliud est, nisi Deum ipsum hominibus emancipare, humanoque tribunali fistere coeli fabricatorem? Deus erit Deus, erit quae est Dei Scriptura, quantumlibet reclamantibus Roma, Tridento, Orco: Et in nos istud artissime teneamus, nulla nobis cum Deo pax erit, ni denegemus, nulla cum Pontificijs.

page.notes: The woodcut ornament below the text is not transcribed. The faint right-margin and lower-left text is show-through from the reverse page and is omitted. The text "sancto" is printed "sanĉto" with a ligature-like c; read as sancto. The signature "SECT." sits at the foot right, with a bar after it.
